description: One record per TikTok comment or reply, with text, like/reply counts, pinned/hearted flags, reply-thread links, and commenter details.

commentId.description: Unique numeric ID of the comment or reply.
commentId.title: Comment ID

createdAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the comment was posted.
createdAt.title: Created At

isLikedByAuthor.description: True if the video author has liked this comment.
isLikedByAuthor.title: Liked by Author

isPinnedByAuthor.description: True if the comment is pinned by the video author.
isPinnedByAuthor.title: Pinned by Author

isReply.description: True when this row is a reply to another comment rather than a top-level comment.
isReply.title: Is Reply

isTranslatable.description: Whether TikTok offers a translation for this comment.
isTranslatable.title: Is Translatable

language.description: Detected language code of the comment (e.g. 'en', 'es'). May be absent.
language.title: Language

likeCount.description: Number of likes on the comment.
likeCount.title: Likes

postId.description: Numeric ID of the TikTok video this comment belongs to.
postId.title: Post ID

replyCount.description: Total number of direct replies to this comment.
replyCount.title: Reply Count

replyToCommentId.description: ID of the root comment this row replies to. Present only on reply rows.
replyToCommentId.title: Reply To Comment ID

replyToNickname.description: Display name of the comment/reply being answered (reply rows).
replyToNickname.title: Reply To Nickname

replyToReplyId.description: For nested replies, the ID of the reply this row answers.
replyToReplyId.title: Reply To Reply ID

replyToUserId.description: Numeric user ID of the comment/reply being answered (reply rows).
replyToUserId.title: Reply To User ID

replyToUsername.description: Handle of the comment/reply being answered (reply rows).
replyToUsername.title: Reply To Username

scrapedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the row was collected.
scrapedAt.title: Scraped At

shareUrl.description: TikTok share link that opens this comment.
shareUrl.title: Share URL

text.description: The text content of the comment or reply.
text.title: Comment Text

threadId.description: ID grouping a root comment with its replies, when TikTok provides one.
threadId.title: Thread ID

video.description: Caption, author and stats of the source video (only when 'Include video metadata' is on).
video.title: Video Metadata

title: TikTok Comment & Reply Thread Extractor Output
